preconditions.description: The number of nodes in the tree s is between 2 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= n and 1 <= bi <= n and ai != bi for ai, bi in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct nodes within the range [1, n].
The number of edges is exactly n - 1, forming a tree.

postconditions.description: The number of nodes in the T-decomposition is between 1 and n.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= ki <= n for ki in k_values)
postconditions.description: Each node in the T-decomposition contains between 1 and n nodes from the original tree.
The total number of nodes in the T-decomposition equals the number of nodes in the original tree.

postconditions.expression: all(len(node) == ki for ki, node in zip(k_values, nodes))
postconditions.description: Each node in the T-decomposition contains exactly ki nodes from the original tree.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= pi <= m and 1 <= qi <= m and pi != qi for pi, qi in edges_t_decomp)
postconditions.description: Each edge in the T-decomposition connects two distinct nodes within the range [1, m].
The number of edges in the T-decomposition is exactly m - 1, forming a tree.

postconditions.expression: all(any(a in node and b in node for node in nodes) for a, b in edges)
postconditions.description: For any edge (a, b) in the original tree, there exists a node in the T-decomposition containing both a and b.

postconditions.expression: all(all(c in node for c in path) for a, b in edges for node in nodes if a in node and b in node for path in paths(a, b))
postconditions.description: If nodes a and b are in the same node of the T-decomposition, all nodes on the path between a and b in the original tree are also in that node.

postconditions.expression: min(w for w in weights) == min(weights)
postconditions.description: The weight of the T-decomposition is minimized.

postconditions.expression: m == min(m for m in decompositions if min(w for w in weights) == min(weights))
postconditions.description: The T-decomposition has the minimum number of nodes among all optimal T-decompositions.
